name: sunny-g1-blocker-resolution-phase2j
resolution_principles: Close G1 entry gates only with independently reviewed design/approval evidence, not future G1 measured results
Designing or reviewing an artifact alone must not flip its gate status or authorize network traffic
Cannot use synthetic time/provenance flags, digest checks or successful CI as actual Windows transport evidence
Unbounded pre-handler occupancy or unsafe abort is NO-GO; examine a different isolated transport design if necessary
Independent manual stop and buffer quarantine required before any future experiment
Consent for this G0 plan never grants permission for G1 execution, runtime modification, installed game access or main merge

packets.objective: Choose a credible pre-handler timing/cap and raw-wire observation approach, or record a blocking transport choice
Specify abort, completion/ownership quarantine and a safe isolated testbed independent emergency stop
Ratify experiment-only limits and review redaction, fixture source, 37-case evidence/verdict charter
Seek a new scope-specific user/operator authorization only after every other entry gate is independently resolved

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed strategy to observe or enforce first-byte/connection timing before GetContextAsync and account for HTTP.sys queueing
entries.deliverable: Source-reviewed pre-handler timing/queue instrumentation feasibility memo with a safe fallback if first-byte origin cannot be evidenced
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Reviewed feasibility of obtaining an authoritative first-byte or connection anchor OR an enforceable equivalent before handler; unknown platform behavior explicitly reserved for G1 measurement
entries.explicit_fallback: NO-GO for HttpListener route if no safe independent method; compare alternate isolated transport designs offline
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: explicitly bounded headers, pending connections and HTTP.sys queue without unapproved machine-wide configuration
entries.deliverable: Pre-auth socket, header, kernel-queue and pending read saturation-control feasibility matrix without OS-wide changes
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Source-reviewed method to bound pre-handler occupancy and fail safely on overload, independent of post-handler ticket counting; actual effectiveness remains a G1 measurement
entries.explicit_fallback: NO-GO if chosen API cannot bound pre-handler work without unauthorized OS modifications
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: source-backed observation plan for original request-target, Host, duplicate headers, peer and kernel-vs-handler behavior
entries.deliverable: Three-source raw target/Host/duplicate-header/peer observation and kernel-vs-handler denial feasibility matrix
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Reviewed per-field observation method and unobservable/BLOCK fallback; do not require already-measured Windows results for G1 entry
entries.explicit_fallback: Block raw-dependent security claims or choose an alternate transport if original-wire fidelity cannot be established
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed request-vs-listener abort method, bounded collateral shutdown and independent operator stop outside the saturated listener; no claim while reads remain pending
entries.deliverable: Request-scoped versus listener-wide abort and independent operator stop source/interface proposal with finite deadlines and collateral invalidation
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Independently reviewed stop/abort method, finite escalation and ownership plan not requiring a responsive listener, with unproven behavior explicitly labeled future G1
entries.explicit_fallback: NO-GO if the proposed test cannot safely stop a hung request or saturated listener
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed observation plan for read completion, buffer quarantine, late callbacks and bounded teardown; latched halt, manual rollback and no automatic restart
entries.deliverable: Per-request read completion, buffer ownership, late callback quarantine and deterministic teardown evidence schema
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Reviewed lifecycle/teardown method preserving held resources until actual completion and manual rollback after uncertain stop
entries.explicit_fallback: Quarantine uncertain state and block restart; never count process exit or HTTP 408 as completion
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed disposable loopback server/client and manual rollback design, explicit endpoint/process inventory including a second disposable port only if approved, otherwise offline mismatch fixture
entries.deliverable: Minimal disposable-only test executable source/design and explicit process/endpoint inventory with independent stop and rollback
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Reviewed, bounded, loopback-only and non-invasive executable/test source design, not a run, with a specific isolation/teardown method and no existing service probes
entries.explicit_fallback: NO-GO if process separation or teardown cannot be justified without running on installed Sunny
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed evidence scrub policy, no P1/user diary/game/token material, no automatic OS edits, no side-effects
entries.deliverable: Redaction allowlist and sanitized evidence writer schema with retained unknown provenance and zero private-field exposure
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Independently reviewed minimal evidence fields and negative privacy leak cases; no actual user content/logs collected
entries.explicit_fallback: Stop evidence collection if unredacted tokens or P1/game data would enter artifacts
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: independent experiment-only approval of finite total/header/body/cleanup/response-write time, byte sizes, pre-auth connections, concurrency and backlog bounds before bind
entries.deliverable: Reviewed experiment-only time/bytes/connection/queue/response/stop budget decision with rationale and rollback impact
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Independent reviewer ratifies or revises every applicable numerical limit for the disposable G1 run, without asserting Windows enforcement is proven
entries.explicit_fallback: Keep G1 NO-GO; proposed 8/2/5/2 seconds and capacity numbers are not automatic defaults
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: vetted raw-byte fixture catalog that distinguishes permitted good requests, malformed inputs and safe response behavior
entries.deliverable: Reviewed bounded synthetic sendable fixture source, variant-to-case matrix, finite rates, approved endpoint binding and non-private response rules
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Review of source and exact 37-case probe/variant manifest, no test traffic, including 16383/16384/16385 byte bounds and pipelining separation
entries.explicit_fallback: Do not run ambiguous, unbounded or endpoint-discovering fixtures
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: reviewed per-case GO/FAIL/BLOCK thresholds for 37 G1 entries, kernel-vs-handler denial, unknown/fail, and rollback
entries.deliverable: Per-case observation/verdict and escalation charter, including BLOCK on unknown, kernel-vs-handler provenance and independent outcome review
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Reviewer accepts attribution, outcomes, evidence and stop criteria for all 37 G1 cases; no requirement to have run them before G1 entry
entries.explicit_fallback: Any unobservable critical field remains BLOCK and requires review/redesign; never convert missing proof to passing status
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

entries.source_required_artifact: explicit new user/operator approval of exact build, disposable endpoint/process inventory, fixtures, finite traffic and duration caps, independent stop owner and manual rollback
entries.deliverable: Separate, explicit user/operator decision for named build/port/fixtures/rates/numerical limits/owner/stop/rollback after independent reviews
entries.entry_closure_evidence: Explicit per-experiment authorization recorded with exact target and scope; no approval inferred from general permission to continue G0
entries.explicit_fallback: Remain NO-GO; never open a listener, reserve a Windows port or send HTTP probes
entries.notes: A completed G0 artifact is not G1 entry approval; future measured G1 results belong in a separately approved record.

g1_exit_requirements: After separately authorized G1: independently measured outcomes of all 37 isolated Windows transport cases; none are prerequisites for G1 entry.
g2_exit_requirements: Separate 13 runtime/privacy/Luna cases and all-route security/lease/epoch/unknown-effect work; not discharged by G1.
prohibited_actions: modify installed Sunny, Luna, SMAPI, Stardew saves
claim ratified limits or Windows acceptance
